TenantHeader.description: the tenant a box names on the api host (spec 026 §4); a browser session uses its active tenant
TenantHeader.name: X-Spool-Tenant

BadRequest.description: Bad Request: the body or a parameter is invalid

Forbidden.description: Forbidden: not a member, wrong tenant, or the role lacks the permission

Unauthorized.description: Unauthorized: no member session or token

bearerToken.description: Authorization: Bearer <token>, only where the route door accepts one: a view token on the view door, a box upload token on file routes, an operator id token on the operator invite and member routes.

memberSession.description: a signed-in member session (humanTenant, internal/hub/resolve.go); the cookie name is SPOOL_HUB_AUTH_COOKIE_NAME. Operator routes (x-role: operator) take the same session, active in the operator workspace with the admin role.
memberSession.name: spool_session

info.description: The hub /v1 API (spec 104). Hand-written; internal/hub/openapi_routes_test.go fails when a route and this file disagree. info.version is replaced by the running hub version when served.
info.title: spool hub API
